summary: CenterPoint Energy, Inc., CenterPoint Energy Houston Electric, LLC and CenterPoint Energy Resources Corp. filed a joint 8-K dated September 9, 2026, reporting entry into and termination of material definitive agreements and creation of a direct financial obligation, alongside other events and exhibits. The excerpt discloses no stake, price per share, premium, advisor or board recommendation; the only concrete items are registered securities such as Houston Electric's 6.95% general mortgage bonds due 2033 and Resources' 6.625% senior notes due 2037. The filing appears to be ordinary financing and agreement housekeeping rather than a special situation. Watch for any subsequent tender, redemption or asset-sale terms.
